Variants.Content: The hills, mines, ports, and House Lannister of the Westerland have shaped a society where wealth, debt, and family respectability are all important. Gold and silver can buy armor, marriage alliances, mercenaries and palace influence, but they cannot automatically grow food or guard mountain passes; the prosperity of the Western TerritoryRong still relies on miners, caravans, manors, Lannisport and vassal network. Nobility valued prestige and repaying old debts, while commoners knew that mines, roads, and taxes were closer to daily life than golden coats of arms. The ruthlessness or generosity of people in the West is often attributed to wealth by outsiders. The real root cause lies in how resources are concentrated and distributed.
